searchTerms.title: 🔍 What businesses to target
searchTerms.description: Business types / keywords as you would type them into Google Maps, e.g. "dentist", "plumber", "real estate agency", "restaurant". One search runs per term per location.

locations.title: 📍 Locations
locations.description: Any city, neighbourhood, region or postal code, e.g. "Toronto, ON, Canada", "Salt Lake, Kolkata", "Austin, TX", "M5V 2T6".

maxPlacesPerSearch.title: Max businesses per search term & location
maxPlacesPerSearch.description: Google Maps shows ~120 results per search. Turn on Deep search below to go beyond that for big cities.

deepSearch.title: Deep search (split location into a grid)
deepSearch.description: Geocodes the location and searches every cell of a grid, to collect far more than 120 businesses in large cities. Slower and uses more compute.

gridSize.title: Grid size for deep search
gridSize.description: 3 = 3×3 = 9 searches per term/location. Use 4–6 for large metros.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google Maps interface language. Keep "en" — the parser is tuned for English labels.

skipClosedPlaces.title: Skip closed businesses
skipClosedPlaces.description: Skip places marked permanently or temporarily closed.

scrapeWebsites.title: Visit websites for emails, owner names & audit
scrapeWebsites.description: Visits each business website (homepage + About/Team/Contact pages) to find emails, owner / founder names, social profiles, and SEO/PPC/web gaps.

maxPagesPerWebsite.title: Max pages per website
maxPagesPerWebsite.description: Homepage plus the most relevant About / Team / Contact pages.

onlyWithEmail.title: Only save leads that have an email
onlyWithEmail.description: Only save businesses where at least one email address was found.

onlyWithoutWebsite.title: Only save businesses WITHOUT a website
onlyWithoutWebsite.description: Great for pure web-development outreach (phone outreach mostly, since these rarely have emails).

minLeadScore.title: Minimum lead score (0–100)
minLeadScore.description: Higher score = bigger marketing gap and easier to reach. 55+ = Hot, 35+ = Warm.

maxRating.title: Only businesses rated at or below
maxRating.description: Optional. e.g. 4.2 to focus on businesses that need reputation / local SEO help.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude businesses containing
excludeKeywords.description: Skip chains or irrelevant results by name/category, e.g. "Walmart", "Tim Hortons", "ATM".

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google blocks heavy scraping. Apify Proxy (RESIDENTIAL recommended for large runs) keeps it stable.

maxConcurrency.title: Browser concurrency (Google Maps)
maxConcurrency.description: How many Google Maps browser pages to process in parallel. Raise together with memory.

websiteMaxConcurrency.title: HTTP concurrency (websites)
websiteMaxConcurrency.description: How many business websites to fetch in parallel.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Run Chrome without a visible window. Keep enabled on Apify.
